description.value: At 3rd level, a chocobo knight can let out a mighty shout, allowing an ally affected by his commander's aura to take additional actions. As an immediate action, a chocobo knight can spend 4 rounds of his commander's aura to grant an ally an additional move action on that ally's turn. A creature can only benefit from this ability once per day even if a different chocobo knight uses it on them. A creature must be able to hear the chocobo knight to gain any benefit from this ability.
